questions.question: Which of the following is a key characteristic of asthma?
options: It is a non-infectious disease that can cause breathing difficulties.
It is an infectious disease passed on by a bacterial pathogen.
It is a lifestyle disease caused primarily by eating a high-fat diet.
It is an illness that only affects the digestive system.

questions.question: What physical change occurs in the respiratory system during an asthma attack?
options: The alveoli expand and lose their elasticity.
The breathing (bronchial) tubes narrow.
The diaphragm becomes completely paralyzed.
The trachea increases in diameter.

questions.question: How is the medication for treating the symptoms of an asthma attack typically delivered?
options: Through an injection into a vein
By taking a liquid syrup orally
Using an inhaler to breathe it directly into the lungs
Applying a medicated patch to the skin.

questions.question: What is the defining feature of an infectious disease?
options: It can only be caused by a poor diet or lack of exercise.
It can be passed from one organism to another.
It is always inherited from a parent through genes.
It cannot be transmitted between different individuals.

questions.question: Which statement correctly describes non-infectious diseases?
options: They are spread easily by coughing or sneezing.
They cannot be passed from one organism to another.
They are always caused by harmful bacteria in the air.
They can only infect younger people.

questions.question: Which combination of factors increases the risk of developing lifestyle diseases?
options: Eating an unbalanced diet and not getting enough exercise.
Washing hands frequently and drinking clean water.
Getting regular vaccinations and plenty of sleep.
Eating a high-fiber diet and walking daily.

questions.question: Which of these sets of behaviors is known to increase the risk of developing lifestyle diseases?
options: Drinking water, sleeping eight hours, and stretching daily.
Smoking, drinking alcohol, and using recreational drugs.
Eating fresh vegetables, cycling, and taking vitamins.
Reducing salt intake, meditating, and swimming.

questions.question: Which of the following is a list of substances commonly consumed as recreational drugs?
options: Paracetamol, penicillin, and aspirin
Insulin, ibuprofen, and throat lozenges
Caffeine, nicotine, and alcohol
Salbutamol, codeine, and antacids.

questions.question: How do depressant drugs affect the human body's nervous system?
options: They speed up reflexes and make the heart beat faster.
They slow down thinking and reaction times.
They prevent any sensory information from reaching the brain.
They immediately improve memory and focus.

questions.question: What is a typical effect of a stimulant drug on a person?
options: It causes drowsiness and slows down physical coordination.
It makes them feel more alert and can give them quicker thinking and reaction times.
It acts as an anesthetic and numbs all physical pain.
It slows down their breathing and heart rate.

questions.question: Which of the following are examples of illegal stimulants used as recreational drugs?
options: Cocaine and ecstasy
Caffeine and nicotine
Aspirin and ibuprofen
Alcohol and paracetamol.

questions.question: What is the primary addictive substance found in tobacco leaves?
options: Carbon monoxide
Tar
Nicotine
Caffeine

questions.question: Smoking tobacco increases the likelihood of developing which set of diseases?
options: Diabetes, osteoporosis, and appendicitis
Asthma, COPD, lung cancer, and heart disease
Measles, mumps, rubella, and chickenpox
Malaria, cholera, tuberculosis, and polio

questions.question: What is the term used for inhaling household chemicals, such as glues or gases, to become intoxicated?
options: Solvent abuse
Depressant simulation
Vaping therapy
Vaccine administration

questions.question: How is vaping generally classified in relation to traditional smoking?
options: It is a completely risk-free medical cure for asthma.
It is an alternative to smoking that still involves consuming nicotine.
It is a type of solvent abuse using paint thinners.
It is an infectious disease of the gas exchange system.

questions.question: Why might scientific guidance or ideas about the health risks of new substances, like e-cigarettes, change over time?
options: Because scientific facts are completely rewritten every year regardless of data.
Because scientific ideas are updated as new evidence emerges.
Because government laws are always based on random choices rather than facts.
Because older scientific theories are automatically considered wrong after ten years.
